plan.archetype: AoE tempo into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring efficient AoE to remove followers quickly, sustained damage for the priest, improved block and weakness, and useful potions.
plan.summary: Prioritize immediate damage and AoE before slow powers. Build poison scaling with reliable defense, remove Strikes, and take elites when health and potions support them. No calibrated damage gap is available.
